alt: Emily Carter's three-page synthetic intake PDF is rendered page by page to PNG images with PyMuPDF at 2x scale; a DSPy ChainOfThought module over the PatientExtractionSignature reasons on gemini-2.5-flash and fills a typed Patient, saved as output_patients/Patient_Intake_Form_Emily_Artificial.json with her name, date of birth as 1992-07-22, city, allergies, surgeries and occupation; editing that form re-extracts only its JSON.

run.note: Install DSPy, PyMuPDF and the example
Extract one JSON record per form
